description.title: ביטוח מכלול - ציוד אלקטרוני
description.summary: This table details underinsurance conditions and risk mitigation measures for electronic equipment covered under the 'מכלול' insurance policy. It specifies how liability is adjusted when the insured sum is lower than required and outlines maintenance requirements.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתייחסת לביטוח ציוד אלקטרוני במסגרת פוליסת 'מכלול'. היא מפרטת את תנאי הביטוח במקרה של חסר ביטוח, כלומר כאשר סכום הביטוח שצוין נמוך מהסכום הנדרש, ואת אמצעי הפחתת הסיכון הנדרשים מהמבוטח, כגון הסכם תחזוקה או הקפדה על הוראות היצרן. החישוב של הפחתת אחריות המבטח נעשה ביחס בין סכום הביטוח שצוין בפוליסה לבין הסכום שהיה צריך להיות מבוטח. תנאי חסר הביטוח יחול בנפרד על כל פריט ברשימת הרכוש המבוטח.  סכום הביטוח לציוד אלקטרוני, חסר ביטוח, אמצעי הפחתת סיכון.
notable_values: Maintenance: Valid agreement or manufacturer's instructions
Risk Mitigation: Internal loss or damage

3.6.6.3.3 Underinsurance If, at the time of inception of the insurance, the sum insured specified in the schedule as "the sum insured for electronic equipment" is lower than the sum insured required in accordance with paragraph 3.6.6.3.1 above (basis for determining the sum insured for electronic equipment cover), the insurer's liability will be reduced pro-rata, and will be in accordance with the ratio between the sum insured specified in the schedule for "the sum insured for hardware" and the sum which should have been insured in accordance with paragraph 3.6.6.3.1 above (basis for determining the sum insured for
electronic equipment cover).
This underinsurance condition shall apply separately to each item appearing in the list of the insured property.
3.6.6.3.4 Risk mitigation measures Measures to mitigate the insurer's risk for the purpose of this chapter Insofar as referring to internal loss or damage which is sustained by the insured property under this cover - the insured shall have a valid maintenance agreement with a computer/ electronic equipment maintenance company, or alternatively, the insured shall ensure proper maintenance of the insured property in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.

טבלה: ביטוח מכלול - ציוד אלקטרוני
This table details underinsurance conditions and risk mitigation measures for electronic equipment covered under the 'מכלול' insurance policy. It specifies how liability is adjusted when the insured sum is lower than required and outlines maintenance requirements.
ממדים: Condition/Requirement, Aspect of Electronic Equipment Insurance

3.6.6.3.3 Underinsurance If, at the time of inception of the insurance, the sum insured specified in the schedule as "the sum insured for electronic equipment" is lower than the sum insured required in accordance with paragraph 3.6.6.3.1 above (basis for determining the sum insured for electronic equipment cover), the insurer's liability will be reduced pro-rata, and will be in accordance with the ratio between the sum insured specified in the schedule for "the sum insured for hardware" and the sum which should have been insured in accordance with paragraph 3.6.6.3.1 above (basis for determining the sum insured for
electronic equipment cover).
This underinsurance condition shall apply separately to each item appearing in the list of the insured property.
3.6.6.3.4 Risk mitigation measures Measures to mitigate the insurer's risk for the purpose of this chapter Insofar as referring to internal loss or damage which is sustained by the insured property under this cover - the insured shall have a valid maintenance agreement with a computer/ electronic equipment maintenance company, or alternatively, the insured shall ensure proper maintenance of the insured property in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.
